map.每步转动角度。: The rotation angle of each step.
map.θ=360/200=1.8°；每转 200 整步，细分可进一步减小。: θ = 360/200 = 1.8°; a revolution takes 200 full steps and microstepping can reduce the angle further.
map.θ=0.9°，步距减半精度更高。: θ = 0.9°; halving the step angle gives higher accuracy.
map.驱动器将整步细分（如 1/16）得更小等效步距但力矩略降。: The driver subdivides each full step, by 1/16 for example, giving a smaller equivalent step at slightly lower torque.
map.开环无反馈，过载/高速会丢步，需留余量或加编码。: With no feedback in open loop, overload or high speed causes lost steps, so leave a margin or add an encoder.

Validation: the single field is required valid via the input guard, otherwise a prompt stops the run.
